intro: Ten rambutans have about 120 kcal. Almost all the calories come from the natural sugar in the flesh.

variants.name: Canned rambutan in syrup (1 small bowl)

diet: Yes. Rambutan is delicious and moderate in calories if you count them. The challenge is fruit season, when there's a big pile on the table and we keep eating while chatting. Take 10 on a plate, then stop.
tips: Count 10 and put them in your own bowl, don't eat straight off the bunch.
Have rambutan as dessert instead of kuih or a sweet drink.
Eat them with a small handful of nuts or a boiled egg if you want to feel fuller.

swap.name: Fresh rambutan instead of canned
swap.why: The canned version is usually soaked in sugar syrup, so it has more calories for the same amount of fruit.

faq.a: Many people believe so, but there's no strong evidence. If you feel uncomfortable, eat fewer and drink enough water.
Raw rambutan seeds are not recommended. Just eat the flesh.

faq.q: When is rambutan season in Malaysia?
faq.a: Usually around mid-year, roughly June to August, and sometimes at year-end depending on the area.
